Preconditions: Admin authenticated via OAuth2 password grant (no client_id); PageBuilder module deployed

[ACT] [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/search with body {storeId: '@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)', lifecycle: 'drafts', take: 10} and Bearer token
[ACT] [STATUS] Verify HTTP 200
[ACT] [BODY] Verify results[] only includes groups where at least one page has status=Draft (lifecycle matches ANY page in the group, not the group's single top-level status field)
[ACT] [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/search with body {storeId: '@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)', lifecycle: 'active', take: 10}
[ACT] [STATUS] Verify HTTP 200
[ACT] [BODY] Verify results[] only includes groups with a Published page whose StartDate/EndDate window includes now
[ACT] [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/search with body {storeId: '@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)', lifecycle: 'archived', take: 10}
[ACT] [STATUS] Verify HTTP 200
[ACT] [BODY] Verify results[] only includes groups where every page is Archived, or the group's EndDate has passed
[ACT] [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/search with body {storeId: '@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)', lifecycle: 'pending', take: 10}
[ACT] [STATUS] Verify HTTP 200
[ACT] [BODY] Verify results[] only includes groups with a Published page whose StartDate is in the future
Assertions: Each lifecycle value ('drafts'|'active'|'archived'|'pending' — lowercase, case-sensitive; the filter is a C# switch on the exact string, unmatched/mismatched values fall through to the unfiltered default) returns HTTP 200 with results[] matching its grouped-page semantics (ApplyLifecycleFilter in GroupedPageSearchService); response includes totalCount and results[] with page metadata (name, permalink, status, startDate, endDate, cultureName)

References: Coverage Gap Analysis COV-2026-03-25-1630; endpoint verified live + against VirtoCommerce.PageBuilderModule Swagger and vc-module-pagebuilder source (GroupedPageSearchService.ApplyLifecycleQuery, ModuleConstants.PageLifecycleFilters) 2026-07-21 — was calling a nonexistent GET /api/page-builder/grouped-pages/search

Title: Asset Library Picker — drag-and-drop upload into dialog
Preconditions: Admin logged in; dialog open at a folder location; local test file available

[ACT] [AUTOMATABLE since 2026-09-10] Supersedes the previous note on this case, which said an OS-filesystem-to-browser drag was impossible with the MCP toolset. The Playwright MCP exposes `browser_drop`, which takes REAL file paths and delivers them to a drop target as if dragged from outside the page; both a plain drop and a colliding drop were driven this way on vcptcore-qa 2026-09-10.
